$comment: BMW-specific fault codes, keyed by module id then 4-digit hex code. Every text is written in our own words, never copied from BMW software or documents. 'seenOn' lists real cars where the code was read with OpenHood. 'source': 'community' means the meaning comes from owner forums and has not been confirmed against a repair; treat it as a lead, not a verdict. Optional 'component' points at a part in components.json. See docs/CONTRIBUTING-DATA.md.

5E18.text: DSC is not getting the data it expects from the engine computer over the CAN bus. Often logged after a low or disconnected battery or work on the engine computer; clear it and see if it returns.

A111.text: Electric steering lock: power supply fault reported by the car access system.

9315.text: The mileage stored in the instrument cluster and its backup copy in another module don't agree.

A731.text: Power supply fault on terminal 30g_f, a switched battery feed the junction box controls. Commonly logged after low battery voltage or the car sitting for a long time.

A670.text: Condensation (fogging) sensor at the base of the rear-view mirror: signal above its expected range. Check the sensor and its connector.
